title: Audi Sport across digital and campaign formats

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Test a sub-brand across different contexts because a distinctive treatment must remain workable beyond one hero composition.
strategic_value: Repeated red statements and the Audi Sport signature can connect campaign imagery with smaller digital interfaces.
demonstration: A white-ground montage groups tablet, phone and watch examples with portrait, people and driving campaign panels, including diagonal and horizontal image interruptions.
practical_value: Compare what survives at watch and phone scale with what can expand across larger image panels.

content_islands.name: Digital group
content_islands.spec: Place the tablet left, phone near the center-right and small watch below.

content_islands.name: Campaign group
content_islands.spec: Overlap a people image above, a split portrait panel at upper right and driving scene at lower right.

content_islands.name: Repeated treatment
content_islands.spec: Repeat red uppercase phrases and Audi Sport signatures while varying image crop and panel shape.

reference_purposes.Expression: Red statement typography and interrupted photographic compositions recur across the montage.
reference_purposes.Application: The source compares tablet, phone, watch and larger campaign formats.
